merged_mining.note: Merged-mines Wcash (WEC) on top of Zcash: one Equihash 200,9 connection, separate ZEC and WEC balances.

pools.source_name: ZecWec pool page + public overview API
pools.notes: Merge-mines ZEC and WEC with the same hashrate. Hashrate is accepted work over the previous 1200 s from ZecWec's public /api/v1/hashrate/pool endpoint (the same reading as the WEC row), refreshed by the server every 45 s. Fee (0 bps) comes from the public /api/v1/overview endpoint; the dashboard describes 'Independent PPLNS allocation' per chain.
